The proposed hub will use the existing external waste and recycling facilities provided by the estate. No additional dedicated internal or external waste storage requiring Council waste services is proposed as part of this micro logistics hub, as any operational waste will be managed by the hub operator.

description: Planning application for the use of part of car park as a last mile logistics hub (Sui Generis): We have submitted a planning application in relation to works on the Lower Ground Floor of the Water Gardens (North) car park on Norfolk Crescent, Tyburnia (W2). The site is owned by the Church Commissioners for England and forms part of The Water Gardens development (The Water Gardens, Burwood Place, London W2 2DA; property reference 010033531191) on the Hyde Park Estate. This application seeks permission to use approximately 1,550 sq ft of space within the Water Gardens (North) car park for a micro logistics hub. The site would be used by Pedal Me low-emission cargo bike couriers, to receive, charge and dispatch deliveries using electrically assisted cargo bikes. No structural alterations are proposed. A secure compound will be formed using mesh metal fencing, with power supplied mostly for cargo bike charging. Pedal Me will operate the site as a micro logistics hub, supporting low-emission last-mile deliveries and micromobility services. Planned operations include same-day relay of fresh produce (e.g. for clients such as Henderson and Shrub), last-mile deliveries from external depots (e.g. Recorra and Lyreco), and on-site battery charging for e-bike operators including Lime and Voi. The hub will include secure areas for bike storage, loading/unloading, battery charging, and micromobility support, all enclosed within the designated compound as agreed with the landlord.
subdivision_of_building: Works on the Lower Ground Floor of the Water Gardens (North) car park on Norfolk Crescent, Tyburnia (W2). The site is owned by the Church Commissioners for England and forms part of The Water Gardens development (The Water Gardens, Burwood Place, London W2 2DA; property reference 010033531191) on the Hyde Park Estate. We have selected “The Water Gardens, Burwood Place, London W2 2DA” (property reference 010033531191) as the application address because this specific car park is not listed as a standalone location on Westminster City Council’s planning records. We have also noted that previous car park related works at this site have been submitted under this address. Please note that on the online Planning Portal (www.planningportal.co.uk), the address appears as “The Water Gardens, Burwood Place, London W2 2DP” rather than W2 2DA.
